panels.title: CPU-время приложения · ramp

targets.rawSql: SELECT r.profile AS "Сценарий", avg(s.cpu_seconds) FILTER (WHERE r.mode='Обычные логи') * 1000 AS "metric_0", avg(s.cpu_seconds) FILTER (WHERE r.mode='Обычные логи + трейсы') * 1000 AS "metric_1", avg(s.cpu_seconds) FILTER (WHERE r.mode='Расширенные логи') * 1000 AS "metric_2", avg(s.cpu_seconds) FILTER (WHERE r.mode='Расширенные логи + трейсы') * 1000 AS "metric_3" FROM resources_summary s JOIN runs r ON r.id=s.run_id WHERE r.profile='ramp' AND r.suite=${suite:sqlstring} AND s.component='backend' GROUP BY r.profile ORDER BY CASE r.profile WHEN 'ramp' THEN 1 WHEN 'stress' THEN 2 WHEN 'soak' THEN 3 WHEN 'soak-10' THEN 4 WHEN 'soak-20' THEN 5 END

WITH values AS (SELECT avg(s.cpu_seconds)*1000 AS cpu FROM resources_summary s JOIN runs r ON r.id=s.run_id WHERE r.suite=${suite:sqlstring} AND r.profile='ramp' AND s.component='backend' GROUP BY r.mode), bounds AS (SELECT min(cpu) AS lo,max(cpu) AS hi FROM values) SELECT greatest(0,lo-greatest((hi-lo)*0.2,abs(hi)*0.00001,0.01)) AS lower,hi+greatest((hi-lo)*0.2,abs(hi)*0.00001,0.01) AS upper FROM bounds

panels.description: CPU-время в миллисекундах. Для сравнения близких значений шкала автоматически приближена и начинается не с нуля.

panels.title: Процессорное время мониторинга

targets.rawSql:
WITH settings AS (
    SELECT
        true AS show_measured,
        true AS show_synthetic
),
measured AS (
    SELECT
        r.profile,
        r.mode,
        avg(s.cpu_seconds) * 1000 AS cpu_ms
    FROM resources_summary s
    JOIN runs r ON r.id = s.run_id
    WHERE r.suite = ${suite:sqlstring}
      AND s.component = 'monitor'
      AND (SELECT show_measured FROM settings)
      AND profile NOT IN (
          'soak',
          'soak-10',
          'soak-20'
      )
    GROUP BY r.profile, r.mode

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        profile,
        mode,
        cpu_seconds * 1000 AS cpu_ms
    FROM synthetic_monitoring_results
    WHERE dataset = 'synthetic-monitoring-seed42-spread1'
      AND synthetic = true
      AND (SELECT show_synthetic FROM settings)
)
SELECT
    CASE profile
        WHEN 'ramp' THEN 'Ramp'
        WHEN 'stress' THEN 'Stress'
        WHEN 'soak-0-syntetic' THEN 'Soak · синтетика'
        WHEN 'soak-10-syntetic' THEN 'Soak-10 · синтетика'
        WHEN 'soak-20-syntetic' THEN 'Soak-20 · синтетика'
        ELSE profile
    END AS "Сценарий",
    max(cpu_ms) FILTER (
        WHERE mode = 'Обычные логи'
    ) AS "metric_0",
    max(cpu_ms) FILTER (
        WHERE mode = 'Обычные логи + трейсы'
    ) AS "metric_1",
    max(cpu_ms) FILTER (
        WHERE mode = 'Расширенные логи'
    ) AS "metric_2",
    max(cpu_ms) FILTER (
        WHERE mode = 'Расширенные логи + трейсы'
    ) AS "metric_3"
FROM measured
GROUP BY profile
ORDER BY CASE profile
    WHEN 'ramp' THEN 1
    WHEN 'stress' THEN 2
    WHEN 'soak' THEN 3
    WHEN 'soak-10' THEN 4
    WHEN 'soak-20' THEN 5
    WHEN 'soak-0-syntetic' THEN 6
    WHEN 'soak-10-syntetic' THEN 7
    WHEN 'soak-20-syntetic' THEN 8
END

panels.description: Сценарии с суффиксом -syntetic — искусственно сгенерированные демонстрационные данные, не измерения CI. Остальные группы — реальные замеры выбранной серии. Длительность реальных сценариев различается.
